Support for a changing world.
With advancements in medical technology and research, there’s never been a more exciting time to be involved in hematology.
As pioneers in our field, our role is to lead the change and find novel ways to incorporate new techniques and therapies into daily practice. We need to rapidly deploy these innovations to fuel our advance towards prevention, a cure, and improved quality of life.
Overview
EHA launched the Topics-in-Focus program to provide support and guidance to hematologists and amplify efforts by focusing on a specific disease related or area related topics to provide better access to innovation.
The program is designed to:
Raise awareness
Provide education
Develop further research frameworks and access
Build a network of experts in specific focus areas
The program has two strands, each with a specific theme:
Precision hematology
Hemoglobinopathies

Shape the future of hematology
June 10–13, 2027
| Barcelona, Spain
Let’s meet at EHA2027, where we connect the global hematology community.
EHA2027 will once again offer an exceptional scientific program, featuring a seamless flow of engagement across plenary sessions—including the opening ceremony, plenary abstracts session, and presidential sessions—alongside carefully curated sponsored sessions spread throughout each Congress day.
With a comprehensive program and two poster sessions, we look forward to sharing the latest clinical and research updates in hematology with you.
EHA2027 is intended for medical professionals, national hematology societies, patient advocates, medical industry, and media worldwide.
The Congress is not open to the general public.
Patient advocates are welcome to attend scientific sessions.
